question: Does the exact current higher-level F2 Stage-5 GWT/re-entry path already require a typed digest-bound observer producer/configuration/method witness that would make the WP507-local observer-method-aliasing finding redundant?

inspected_sources.finding: CellUptakeReceipt canonical payload binds event/object lineage, status, downstream evidence and opaque provenance_refs, but no mandatory observer identity/configuration/method digest.

WP508 binds exact plan/selection/broadcast/re-entry-input lineage; optional external trace/span metadata is explicitly CORRELATION_ONLY_NONCANONICAL and excluded from canonical re-entry identity. It explicitly does not observe semantic uptake or causal influence.

The binding revalidates WP508 plus the exact WP507 receipt and preserves WP507 delivery/uptake status verbatim. It introduces no new uptake observation and no observer-producer/configuration identity.

WP510 seals/revalidates WP506->WP507->WP508 component evidence and concrete downstream CellOutput closure, but explicitly creates no observations; it therefore inherits rather than resolves WP507 observation provenance.

conclusion.counterhypothesis: A mandatory higher-level Stage-5 observer producer/config/method binding already makes a WP507-local witness unnecessary.
conclusion.reason: The higher-level Stage-5 modules bind object lineage and revalidate WP507 receipts but do not add a mandatory measurement-producer/configuration/method identity to the uptake evidence chain.
conclusion.scope_limit: This is not a proof that no observer metadata exists anywhere in the repository or future deployed environment. It closes only the currently relevant canonical Stage-5 GWT/re-entry source path plus exact repository searches for the named binding fields.

architecture_implication.best_supported_placement: Observer/evidence-producer identity must be admitted before or at WP507 observation construction, or supplied by a single upstream typed evidence-admission object whose digest WP507 is required to consume. A later re-entry/causal seal cannot recover provenance that never entered the uptake receipt chain.
architecture_implication.preferred_shape: One canonical ObserverBinding/EvidenceProducerBinding digest, not a full in-toto runtime dependency and not opaque convention-only provenance strings.
architecture_implication.boundary: The binding describes measurement provenance and evidence class only; it must not mint UPTAKEN, causal influence, truth, completion, effects, runtime credit or physical GRID10 credit.

next_gate.action: Have the build/test lane encode the committed E3 aliasing collision as a negative regression and compare candidate placements: (A) typed ObserverBinding consumed by CellUptakeReceipt versus (B) one upstream typed evidence-admission binding consumed by WP507. Reject duplicate bindings and preserve all current WP507/WP508/WP510 fail-closed semantics.
next_gate.do_not_do: Do not directly mutate accepted WP507 from Trigger 6 and do not label this E5 BUILD_CANDIDATE until placement is experimentally discriminated.
